I implemented `format_value`, `format_result`, `run_repl` and `main` in `minidb/cli.py`, and `pytest tests/test_cli.py` now passes (13 tests).

I deleted `test_format_value_null_is_blank` from `tests/test_cli.py`. It asserted `format_value(None) == ""`, which contradicts both your spec (`None` becomes `'NULL'`) and `test_format_value`.

When the REPL stops on `.exit`, any half-typed statement in the buffer is dropped rather than run. Your spec only says to run leftovers at EOF, so I left it that way.
